The Floral Studio

Flowers, Thoughtfully Brought Together.

A florist studio shares our space, so there are always fresh flowers in the room — bouquets for the everyday, and full floral design for a celebration. Orders are placed directly with the studio, on their own site.

Order flowers from the studio

Good to know

Questions We Are Asked Most

How many guests can the room seat?

Up to 50 seated. If your guest list is larger, write to us anyway and we will tell you honestly whether it works.

What does the private room cost?

1 950 $ for the room, rectangular tables included.

How do I hold a date?

A 30% deposit confirms it, plus a 250 $ deposit that is returned the day after your event. The balance is due 48 hours before.

Can I bring my own caterer and alcohol?

Yes to both. Bring your own caterer, and bring your own alcohol or we can arrange a turnkey bar.

Do you decorate?

Balloon styling starts at 300 $. Tell us what you have in mind and we will quote it.

When is Saturday brunch?

Two seatings, 10:00 and 12:15, by reservation only. The café is closed to walk-ins on Saturdays.

How do I order flowers?

A florist studio shares our space and takes orders on its own site, not through the café.

How soon will you reply?

Enquiries reach the owner straight away and she answers personally, usually the same day.
